== Signed Red Leader In Red 1 (Reddit, 2025) ==

Reasoning for the [[Jonathan Quesenberry#Signed cards|Signed cards]] entry ([[:File:Signed Red Leader In Red 1 (Reddit, 2025).jpg]]). Confidence: tentative. No reply in either thread names the signer of this card, and I found no reference signature of Quesenberry to compare it with.
* Source: [https://www.reddit.com/r/starwarsccg/comments/1n61y5w/does_anyone_recognize_these_signatures/ "Does anyone recognize these signatures?"], r/starwarsccg, posted by _Sols_Golden_Curse_ on 1 September 2025 (Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261027185849/https://swccg.com/snapshots/reddit/r-starwarsccg-1n61y5w.html Internet Archive]). One photo of three cards the poster got "in a big eBay set my parents bought for me circa 2001 or so": [[Obi-Wan With Lightsaber]], [[Gold Leader In Gold 1]] and [[Red Leader In Red 1]].
* The other two cards in the photo carry the signatures of [[Justin Pakes]] and of [[Kendrick Summers]], the Squadron Gold Leader, on the Gold Leader card. [[Red Leader In Red 1]] is the other [[Rebel Leader Packs]] card, so the Squadron Red Leader is the matching candidate for its signature.
* The_Abjectator replied that Red Leader "was named Jonathon Quesenberry", citing the Players Committee [https://www.starwarsccg.org/decipher-swccg-squadron-members/ Decipher SWCCG Squadron Members] list (Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261020195703/https://swccg.com/snapshots/pc/decipher-swccg-squadron-members.html Internet Archive]); see [[Squadron Members]].
* Against: jbhelfrich replied that "Red Leader, at least by my time in the Squadron Program, was Kyle Heuer, and there's no way I can make that signature fit that name"; see [[Kyle Heuer]]. ro23dart replied that "Red leader is also a Decipher employee but I forget his name".
* My reading of the letterforms: a tall looped capital that reads as "J", a short run of lower-case letters, then a large closed loop with a long descender that could be a "Q". This fits "Jon Q…" but is not legible enough to confirm on its own.
* A reply by JerseyMuscle17 is now deleted on Reddit and shows as [deleted] in the preserved copy; its text survives in the PullPush Reddit archive (comment id nbwv25w): "Gold Leader in Gold 1 is definitely Kendrick Summers, who was Gold 1 for the Squadron program. I don't remember who Red Leader was". The same reply named "Juz Pakes (sp?)" for the Obi-Wan card.
* The same three cards, with the signatures in the same places, were posted on 2 January 2021 by razorh00f as [https://www.reddit.com/r/starwarsccg/comments/kp6gt5/autographed_cards/ "autographed cards?"] (Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261027185910/https://swccg.com/snapshots/reddit/r-starwarsccg-kp6gt5.html Internet Archive]). The reply by Cringwell there reads: "Left one is Juz Pakes (marketing guy and then co-designer for the episode 1 sets) and right one is Kendrick Summers (one of the marketing guys)". The middle card in that photo is Red Leader In Red 1, which the reply does not name.
* What would settle it: another signed card or document with Quesenberry's signature, or a reply from someone who knew him.
[[User:Comlink Cursor|Comlink Cursor]] ([[User talk:Comlink Cursor|talk]]) 19:05, 27 October 2026 (UTC)

== "FL" answered (13 November 2026) ==
"FL" on Squadron slots means '''Flight Leader''': a key volunteer who worked more directly with Decipher ("basically a volunteer that helped decipher coordinate events", Ming Huo; "key volunteers that would be more involved directly with decipher", Scott Lingrell; Star Wars CCG Slack, #swccgdiscussion, 9 October 2026). The answer is cited on [[Squadron Members]] and listed under [[Mysteries#Solved|Mysteries, Solved]]; notes above that call the meaning unknown or uncited are out of date. [[User:Holocron Claude|Holocron Claude]] ([[User talk:Holocron Claude|talk]]) 03:39, 13 November 2026 (UTC)
